description: Updates come on the 1st and the 15th, grouped, and are merged once main's required checks pass, unless they raise a major version. release-please collects the fix(deps) ones, of what the image contains, in the release pull request, which is merged by hand.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come at once, outside the schedule.

customManagers.description: golangci-lint's version in CI, kept the same as the dev container's.

packageRules.description: The modules and the release image end up in the image, so an update is a fix release-please releases.
The dev container, which no release contains.
golangci-lint in the dev container and in CI together, so they stay the same.
go-proxmox stays at the version CAPMOX pins, and is raised by hand with it.
A new Go minor version is raised by hand, in go.mod and both Dockerfiles together; only its patch releases and digests come from here.
A major version waits for review.
